result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks and mature trees, providing a generally walkable environment. However, the lack of marked crossings and the presence of parked cars on both sides create visibility challenges, and the pavement on the left side shows signs of degradation.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the narrow street limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the block

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and debris in the gutter area on the left side of the street create uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway adjacent to the fence

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections to improve visibility and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings at the nearest intersections to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and debris, improving the walking surface near the curb.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a narrow residential street where buildings are situated directly at the sidewalk edge. The walkway is significantly compromised by large utility poles placed in the center of the path and vehicles parked on the sidewalk, creating major accessibility barriers.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: Two large utility poles are located directly in the middle of the pedestrian walkway, severely restricting clear width and accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, splitting the sidewalk area

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: A vehicle is parked on the paved area intended for pedestrians, forcing people into the roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked pavement with vegetation growth creates uneven surfaces and potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground near the garage entrance

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone or widen the sidewalk to ensure a continuous clear path of at least 4 feet.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards or a higher curb to physically prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk area.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to remove trip hazards and improve accessibility.

result.summary: The image shows a typical urban residential street with sidewalks on both sides and a stop-controlled intersection ahead. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks modern safety features like curb extensions or high-visibility markings, and parked cars may obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs approaching the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Road Edge
hazards.description: Accumulated debris and uneven pavement in the gutter area create a tripping hazard for pedestrians entering or exiting the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel-line crosswalk to a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, continuous concrete sidewalk adjacent to a fenced green space, likely a cemetery. While the walkway is clear of obstructions, there is no physical buffer between the pedestrian path and the roadway, and the road surface appears somewhat degraded.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the roadway with no planting strip or parked cars to provide a safety buffer from moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt near the curb is cracked and contains debris, which could pose a splash hazard during rain or a tripping hazard at the curb edge.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom edge of the image, in the roadway.

interventions.title: Install a Furniture Zone or Planting Strip
interventions.description: Create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway using trees, planters, or a grass strip to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Roadway Surface Repair
interventions.description: Repave the edge of the roadway to eliminate cracks and improve drainage near the pedestrian walkway.
